new_problems: A chat read-back card waits 10 minutes (PENDING_TTL_MS). After a later restart it has expired, so 'a Yes after a restart' holds only within that window (real-daemon case restarts on the same clock start). Whether the read-back should live longer is the session lead's decision.

The conversation's 'Note for the next session' textbox is the last textbox on the Overview. A walk script that typed into getByRole('textbox').last() saved a note there (not an app bug, but the Chat tab is not reachable by ?tab=chat).
notes_for_other_areas: ConversationCommands gains optional planFix(changes, turn, {level, readBack, askFirst?, ask?}) and recompose(pendingIds, turn) (CommandLoop implements both). The planFix context is built only there.

CommandContext.planFix gains askFirst?: boolean. The executor reads back every change of a planFix context below Standard or with askFirst. StoredCardContext keeps planFix for restorePending. executor.compose(calls, ctx, {ask}) gives a composed card its own question, restored after a restart.
change-card.ts exports oneQuestion. mergeCards' ask is now one question ('A, b and c?'). Any later area that composes cards gets one-question read-backs.
